decision.summary: A broad asymmetric feature in N and E between indices 522–539 shows a rising phase followed by a plateau (N) and partial decline (E), but no confirmed return to baseline before the allowed context ends at 575; U shows no correlated offset. The incomplete reversal and lack of opposing recovery make the interval uncertain.

intervals.observation: N: sustained rise from ~522 to ~532, then plateau until 539; E: delayed rise from ~526 to ~534, followed by partial decline but no return to pre-onset level by 539; U: no coherent offset, remains within noise band. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 575), and interior shows asymmetric platform without clear reversal.
